assert._comment: Mobile is the form factor that gates performance: throttled runs are reproducible enough to hold a number to, and it is how most visitors arrive. aggregationMethod is explicit so the number means one thing - the median of the 3 runs per page, not the best or worst. Across 72 CI runs those medians sat at 0.99-1.00 on every page, so 0.95 leaves headroom for runner noise while still failing a real regression.
